Right-clicks on the Windows desktop, fixed.

- Right-clicking someone in the village, a house, the station, a widget or a shelf could bring up Windows' own desktop menu instead of the village's, and slowly. The wallpaper now works out what's under the pointer as it moves, so the mouse hook decides at once: the village's things get the village's menu, and everything else (open ground, the sky, icons) goes straight to Windows with no delay.
- The mouse hook no longer does anything that could keep it waiting. Windows quietly removes a mouse hook that's slow to answer, which left every right-click going to Windows from then on; if it's removed anyway, the wallpaper notices the next time the mouse moves and puts it back.
- Checked at 100% and 150% display scaling.
